FIGlet 2.2.5 renderer logic and distribution fonts
Source: https://github.com/cmatsuoka/figlet, commit 202a0a8110650a943f1125f536b3bb455cf72ee1
Licence: BSD-3-Clause
src/lettering.rs ports figlet's horizontal layout, smushing and word wrap to Rust.
Bundled fonts from fonts/, each trimmed to its header, comments and 102 required
FIGcharacters with a comment line recording the trim: banner, big, block (named
figlet-block), ivrit, lean, mini, mnemonic, script, shadow, slant, small, smscript,
smshadow, smslant and standard.

flf2a$ 6 5 76 15 15 1 16271 0
Ivrit (Hebrew) Unicode font assembled by John Cowan <cowan@ccil.org>
Latin chars from  Standard by G. Chappell & Ian Chai
Hebrew chars from Jerusalem by Gedaliah Friedenberg <gfrieden@nyx.cs.du.edu>
        Use "ilhebrew.flc" for Hebrew keyboard mapping
        Use "ushebrew.flc" for U.S.-style keyboard mapping ("febrew" script)
        Use "8859-8.flc" for ISO 8859-8 text
        Or use UTF-8

--- mnemonic.flf header ---
flf2a$ 1 1 12 -1 6 0 0 0
mnemonic - a FIGfont by John Cowan <cowan@@ccil.org>
This font uses the mnemonics of RFC1345
(http://ds.internic.net/rfc/rfc1345.txt) to implement a really large character
set rather crudely, but reversibly.  Two-letter mnemonics
are prefixed by &; larger mnemonics are prefixed by &_ and followed by _.
Trimmed to the 102 required FIGcharacters by ApollinairesASCII contributors, 2026.

Modified for figlet 2.2 by John Cowan <cowan@ccil.org>
  to add Latin-{2,3,4,5} support (Unicode U+0100-017F).
Permission is hereby given to modify this font, as long as the
modifier's name is placed on a comment line.

---

Modified by Paul Burton <solution@earthlink.net> 12/96 to include new parameter
supported by FIGlet and FIGWin.  May also be slightly modified for better use
of new full-width/kern/smush alternatives, but default output is NOT changed.

Modified 2012-05 by Patrick Gillespie (patorjk@gmail.com) to add the 0xCA0 character.
Trimmed to the 102 required FIGcharacters by ApollinairesASCII contributors, 2026.

TOIlet fonts
Source: https://github.com/cacalabs/toilet, commit 3eb9d58037afb0a1baec6dca82caa045fb2217c0
Licence: WTFPL-2
Bundled fonts from fonts/, extracted from their ZIP containers and trimmed to their
header, comments and 102 required FIGcharacters with a comment line recording the trim:
ascii9, ascii12, bigascii9, bigascii12, smascii9 and smascii12.
